blogs.title: Direct Preference Optimization: A Friendly Guide to RL‑free Alignment
blogs.description: An approachable walkthrough of DPO: why RLHF pipelines are complex, how DPO replaces them with a simple classification loss, and what this means for students and practitioners who want stable, steerable language models.

blogs.title: Implementing DPO End‑to‑End: A Practical Tutorial with Open‑Source Tools
blogs.description: A step‑by‑step guide to training an SFT model, building a preference dataset, setting a reference policy, and optimizing the DPO objective using popular libraries. Includes tips for batching, logging, and monitoring KL.

blogs.title: DPO vs PPO vs Best‑of‑N: Choosing the Right Alignment Strategy
blogs.description: A decision guide comparing compute cost, stability, data needs, and performance tradeoffs. Covers when to prefer DPO, when PPO still makes sense, and where Best‑of‑N reranking fits in production.

blogs.title: Why Your Language Model Is Secretly a Reward Model
blogs.description: An intuitive explanation of the change‑of‑variables idea behind DPO, the Bradley‑Terry preference model, and how policy log‑probabilities implicitly encode a reward function without training a separate reward model.

blogs.title: Tuning β and Picking a Reference Policy: DPO Hyperparameters That Matter
blogs.description: Practical guidance on selecting β to control KL, initializing and training a reference model when SFT isn’t available, handling distribution shift, and avoiding degeneration with proper weighting.

blogs.title: Building Great Preference Datasets for DPO
blogs.description: Best practices for collecting and cleaning pairwise preferences, mixing human and AI feedback, balancing positive/negative pairs, and designing prompts that surface useful differences between responses.

blogs.title: Evaluating DPO Models: Win Rates, Humans in the Loop, and Automated Judges
blogs.description: A survey of evaluation strategies, from human preference studies to LLM judges, with guidance on prompt design, temperature sensitivity, and how to interpret win‑rate vs. KL tradeoffs.

blogs.title: Beyond Text: Applying DPO to Images, Audio, and Code Generation
blogs.description: Explores how the DPO recipe generalizes to other modalities and tasks. Discusses preference schemas for non‑text outputs, reference policy choices, and potential pitfalls in multimodal settings.

blogs.title: Debugging DPO: Common Failure Modes and How to Fix Them
blogs.description: A troubleshooting playbook covering data noise, preference inconsistencies, over‑optimization, degeneration with naive losses, and KL drift. Includes interventions like β scheduling and data curation.

blogs.title: From Research to Production: Shipping a DPO‑Aligned Assistant
blogs.description: Operational advice for deploying DPO‑trained models: serving considerations, inference‑time sampling settings, guardrails, online preference collection, and safe model updates over time.

blogs.title: DPO on a Budget: How Small Teams Can Train Helpful Models
blogs.description: Cost‑savvy strategies for startups and students: reusing public preference datasets, lightweight SFT, efficient fine‑tuning, and data augmentation to get strong alignment without PPO‑level compute.

blogs.title: RLAIF Meets DPO: Using AI‑Generated Preferences to Scale Alignment
blogs.description: A practical look at combining rule‑based or LLM‑generated critiques with DPO. Covers rubric design, quality control for synthetic labels, and when to mix human and AI feedback for best results.
